left_vessel_tower.description: The most dominant visual element of the folio: a tall vertical column of three stacked ornate vessels/urns positioned along the left margin. Each vessel has a complex tiered profile — wide body, narrow neck, flared lip, pedestal base — with detailed decorative banding. The topmost vessel is smallest; the bottommost is the largest and most elaborate with a wide footed base. All three are rendered with the same color palette. This column acts as a persistent left-margin illustration running from y≈60 to y≈900.
left_vessel_tower.color: Primary body: deep red (vermilion/red lead). Decorative bands and rims: medium green (malachite-like). Highlight rings and pearl-dot details: cream/white. Neck sections: alternating red and green bands. Interior cavity of top vessel: teal-green wash. Overall: red and green are the two dominant colors, creating a strong visual column.

upper_plant_row.description: A horizontal row of approximately 5 plant specimens suspended or displayed across the upper zone of the folio, between x≈200 and x≈920. Each specimen appears to be a root or bulb with hanging fibrous roots below and small sprigs or leaves above. They are arranged loosely in a row, displayed as if hung for drying or examination. Labels (@Lf, f88r.2–6) appear between and beside them. One specimen on the far right has noticeably green leaf tips.
upper_plant_row.color: Root/bulb bodies: warm golden-brown to reddish-brown (raw sienna range). Fibrous root tendrils: pale tan/cream with fine ink lines. Leaf tips (rightmost specimen): medium green. Background: cream parchment. The warm brown dominates this zone.

middle_plant_group.description: A group of approximately 4 smaller plant specimens in the mid-folio zone, positioned between paragraph blocks A and B. These include: small green leaf clusters, bare root forms with long trailing tendrils, and one specimen with a spotted/dotted pattern (possibly a spotted leaf or fungal form). Some specimens have small vessel-like forms attached to their roots. The labels @Lc (f88r.12) and @Lf (f88r.13–17) label these elements.
middle_plant_group.color: Leaves: medium green (flat wash). Root tendrils: warm golden-brown to reddish-brown, same palette as upper row. Spotted specimen: cream/pale base with dark brown ink dots. Small attached vessels: echoing the left column vessels — red body with green rim detail. Background: cream parchment.

lower_plant_with_vine.description: In the lower right zone of the folio, a plant specimen with curling vine-like tendrils and small green leaves. The tendrils curve and loop in an organic, flowing pattern reminiscent of climbing vines. Small rounded or pointed green leaves are distributed along the vine arms. This element continues from the middle zone downward toward the bottom of the folio. The @Lc label f88r.23 and @Lf labels f88r.24–25 annotate this zone.
lower_plant_with_vine.color: Vine stems and tendrils: light tan/golden-brown ink. Leaves: medium green wash. The vine forms are notably more linear and pale than the rooted specimens above.

bottom_wave_form.description: At the very bottom of the folio, a horizontal flowing wave or undulating form — possibly stylized water, a large root system, or a ground line. It has a sinuous, rhythmic quality with multiple crests. Faint reddish-orange lines are visible within it.
bottom_wave_form.color: Outer wave form: pale green-gray wash. Interior detail lines: faint reddish-orange/salmon ink. This is a very subtle, delicate element at the lower edge.
